sloka: पर्यवस्थापयात्मानमनाथं मां च वानर ।सत्यधर्माभिरक्तानां नास्ति मृत्युकृतं भयम् ।। ६.४६.३४ ।।।।
transliteration: paryavasthāpayātmānamanāthaṁ māṁ ca vānara ।satyadharmābhiraktānāṁ nāsti mṛtyukṛtaṁ bhayam ।। 6.46.34 ।।।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana, having spoken in that manner, there after dipped his hand in water and wiped the beautiful eyes of Sugriva to brighten.
